Skills.Name: Cudgel
Skills.Description: Mastery of the maul, the mace, the cudgel — heavy-impact strikes that rattle bone and brain.

Powers.Name: Bludgeon
Powers.Description: Damaging Cudgel-class hits have a 50% chance to stun for 2 turns. Toughness can end the stun early (save 16, easing each turn). Does not extend an existing stun.

Powers.Name: Expertise
Powers.Description: +2 to-hit while wielding a Cudgel-class weapon (Mace / Warhammer / Cudgel / OldWorldPipe).

Powers.Name: Hammer
Powers.Description: Cudgel hits have a small chance to apply Broken to one of the defender's equipped items.

Powers.Name: Shattering Blows
Powers.Description: Cudgel hits have a chance to apply ShatterArmor — the defender's effective AV drops while their armor is cracked.

Powers.Name: Backswing
Powers.Description: When a Cudgel-weapon swing misses, you have a chance to immediately re-attack with the same weapon.

Powers.Name: Conk
Powers.Description: Active ability: targeted strike on an adjacent creature. The conk applies Stunned regardless of swing outcome. 10-turn cooldown. Requires a Cudgel weapon equipped.

Powers.Name: Slam
Powers.Description: Slam the selected adjacent creature up to 3 cells away, then stun it. A wall or creature stops the push: both the target and the physical obstacle take bonus weapon damage. Allies can be struck by this collision. Cooldown 50; requires an equipped Cudgel weapon.

Powers.Name: Charging Strike
Powers.Description: Active ability: charge up to 3 cells in a chosen direction and strike the first creature in your path with +50% bonus damage. 30-turn cooldown. Requires a Cudgel weapon equipped.

Powers.Name: Ground Pound
Powers.Description: Active ability: smash the ground — every adjacent creature takes 75% weapon damage, gets Stunned for 1 turn, and is knocked back 1 cell. 40-turn cooldown. Requires a Cudgel weapon equipped.

Powers.Name: Disarm
Powers.Description: Active ability: smack an adjacent target's equipped weapon out of their hand. The weapon drops on their cell. 50-turn cooldown. Requires a Cudgel weapon equipped.
